input.systemPrompt: You are analyzing workflow execution data to suggest improvements. Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown fences.
input.userPrompt:
Analyze the following workflow execution data and suggest improvements.

WORKFLOW: $executionData.workflow.name
Status: $executionData.workflow.enabled
Definition:
$executionData.workflow.definition

REVIEW NOTES:
$executionData.workflow.reviewNotes

EXECUTION SUMMARY:
- Total executions: $executionData.summary.totalExecutions
- Successful: $executionData.summary.successfulExecutions
- Failed: $executionData.summary.failedExecutions
- LLM actions: $executionData.summary.llmActions
- Graded LLM actions: $executionData.summary.gradedLlmActions
- Average LLM grade: $executionData.summary.avgLlmGrade

RECENT EXECUTIONS:
$executionData.recentExecutions

FAILED EXECUTIONS:
$executionData.failedExecutions

FAILED ACTIONS:
$executionData.failedActions

GRADED ACTIONS:
$executionData.gradedActions

Based on this data and the review notes, suggest improvements in the following JSON format:
{
  "workflow_refinements": [
    {
      "type": "trigger_add" | "trigger_remove" | "prompt_update" | "tts_update",
      "path": "triggers" | "steps.N.input.system_prompt" | "steps.N.input.text",
      "value": "new value for adds/updates",
      "old_value": "existing value for updates/removes",
      "rationale": "why this change improves the workflow"
    }
  ],
  "workflow_expansions": [
    {
      "name": "suggested_workflow_name",
      "triggers": ["phrase one", "phrase two"],
      "rationale": "why this new workflow is needed"
    }
  ],
  "llm_grading_insights": [
    {
      "action_id": 123,
      "suggested_grade": 4,
      "notes": "why this grade based on user's grading patterns"
    }
  ]
}

Return ONLY the JSON, no additional text or markdown fences.
